notes.title: KARNAL 1.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Replaced the knife with a kicking ability.
[*] Ammo and sprinting are now infinite in the final level.
[*] Added a short level before exiting the facility to improve pacing.
[*] Added different backgrounds for the Settings and Lost Tapes menus.
[*] Fixed several bugs.
[*] Disabled texture streaming, as the performance gain was negligible.
[/list]

This will be the final planned update for [b]KARNAL[/b], apart from any necessary bug fixes. I’ll now be focusing on a new game that I’ve been developing, as well as dedicating time to studying.

Thank you to everyone who played [b]KARNAL[/b]!

[*] Added a short level before exiting the facility to improve pacing.
[*] Added different backgrounds for the Settings and Lost Tapes menus.
[*] Disabled texture streaming, as the performance gain was negligible.

notes.title: KARNAL 1.3
notes.content:
[h2]Changes: [/h2]
[list]
[*]Ammo is now limited. It is found for each weapon throughout the levels, and costs money in the arena.

[*]Reworked the Enemy AI, no longer do they walk in a straight line towards you.

[*]Drastically improved detail and changed the structure of the Story Mode levels.

[*]Changed the menu fonts. 

[*]Removed the option to disable Lumen. This was due to many levels now being very different with the feature turned off, possibly affecting gameplay. 

[*]Drastically improved sound design. 

[*]Added footstep sounds. 

[*]Added roughness, metallic and normal maps to the player's weapon sprites. 

[*]Added explosive barrels.

[*]Added new post process effects. 

[*]Added a few new secrets, alongside a new hidden achievement :)

[/list]
[b]And many more bug fixes, balancing changes, etc. 
The previous version, KARNAL 1.2 will be playable through the "Classic" branch.[/b]
